name: pam_ldap
description: LDAP authentication module for network directory services
detailed_description: LDAP authentication module for integrating with network directory services. Enables authentication against centralized LDAP servers, allowing organizations to manage user credentials in a single repository. Supports various LDAP configurations and can be combined with other modules for enhanced security features.
notes:
Enterprise authentication for LDAP-based systems
